summary: Marketing is advancing on multiple fronts, with the CKGSB-IE report nearing finalization, SEO prioritization on Asia Star and Intelligent China, and the knowledge website redesign in progress.
summaryDetail: The CKGSB-IE report is the immediate priority: Felix and Bin Ma are reviewing it, with corrections to titles due by Sept 2 and final sign-off from Prof Li Wei and Dean Haitao imminent. Simultaneously, SEO efforts are focused on ranking for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing programs, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities; Joseph is auditing current SEO presence and drafting target areas. The knowledge website redesign is underway, with a decision to keep the current base but integrate editorial-style elements from Joseph's design, and videos will be folded into topic sections. This week, the team must deliver the bi-weekly GM report, confirm speakers for TIACON26, review booth design for Tech In Asia, and update the Indonesian program webpage with new SEO-friendly copy. Upcoming: the Bayes Business School meeting on Sept 11 and the EV & Smart Mobility event results to be included in the next briefing email.
